# Nyall Negm

> Business Intelligence & Solutions Manager in London. I design and build the data platforms and reporting that leadership teams run on, and I turn manual, spreadsheet-driven work into governed, automated services.

This is a static personal portfolio: plain HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript, no framework, no trackers. Work examples are anonymised, with generic names only and no real data.

## Pages

- [Home](index.html): career story, skills, featured projects and a preview of the BI demo.
- [Platform explorer](explore.html): an interactive map of the kind of data platform I build, with mini demos (executive reporting, automations, a data Q&A desk, a business app and an agent control room). Names and data are invented.
- [Projects](projects.html): anonymised work case studies, each with a demo that runs on invented data, and personal projects built in my own time.
- [Career](career.html): my career as an interactive CV, with a one-page Skim view and a Story view that links each achievement to its demo.
- [Code](projects.html#code): the repositories behind the personal projects, with what each one demonstrates.
- [BI demo](demo.html): a live executive P&L report for a fictional company, Harbour & Pine Outdoor Co. Every figure is invented and generated in the browser.
- [How I work with AI](how-i-work.html): how I run AI agents in delivery, with independent review, tests and a human sign-off before anything reaches production.
